P18.2: the France/Belgium (Technopolice) connectors — prefectural orders → LegalInstrument, DECP → Contract, the non-US records vocabulary, and the OSM import study

The first consumer of the P18.1 adapter framework and its §5.3 stress-test: the
France/Belgium evidence base carries authorization by published prefectural orders
and procurement by a national open-data dataset, and both must map onto existing
entities or it is a §5.3 defect. They map, with no US-shaped assumption:

- connectors.france_belgium: two adapters that reach for no us.* term (the
  MuckRock/foia_request and USAspending/cooperative-US vocabularies are refused).
  * france_belgium_records: the LegalInstrument runtime shape (§11.14, first
    consumer) — a published arrêté préfectoral → instrument_type fr.arrete_prefectoral,
    a national child of the abstract prefectoral_order parent (abstract_instrument_type
    rolls it up, AC2); the internationalized acquisition method fr.cada (FR) /
    no_equivalent_available (BE, the eID-walled register — a known-complete-unknown),
    never foia_request (§13.8, SIG-ONTO-068).
  * france_belgium_procurement: a DECP record → the country-neutral Contract (F9.16);
    a marché riding an accord-cadre is a cooperative_piggyback that MUST set
    parent_cooperative_contract (SIG-ONTO-032), reached through French open data.
- Belgium onboarded under the be.* national namespace (JurisdictionType, OrganizationType,
  LegalInstrumentType) with a BE adapter + BE-GDPR redact-by-default publication; a few
  fr.* org types added (police_nationale/douanes/prefecture). No us.* enum widened
  (frozen us.* baseline asserted). Ontology regenerated; verify-gen byte-clean.
- connectors.osm_import_study: the sous-surveillance.net → OSM import studied as prose
  (docs/studies/) and data — conventions/consultation/outcome, and the corrections to
  the outline's number (~12k → ~18k imported/~20k source) and actor (OSM Belgium /
  User:Vucod, not Technopolice). A gate refuses a SIG-originated contribution at scale
  until the study is complete (SIG-CONTRIB-016).
- Source rows raa_prefectures / madada / declarationcamera_be (ingestion_permitted=false).

Requirement ids: SIG-CHART-029, SIG-ONTO-068, SIG-ONTO-032, SIG-CONTRIB-016; §11.14
LegalInstrument, §13.8 acquisition method, §23.5/§23.6 connectors. ADR-057, traceability,
and the Phase-18 risk register updated; make check green (2363 passed; verify-gen byte-clean).
